title: Own-run wait reports UNKNOWN (process gone) for a passed run after the host wall clock moves backwards
outcome: Own-run wait reports UNKNOWN (process gone) for a passed run after the host wall clock moves backwards
acceptance: A run whose host wall clock moves backwards (or forwards) while it runs is reported by its own-run wait with its real terminal outcome from the persisted result, not UNKNOWN/process-gone; liveness and deadline decisions use a monotonic clock or the persisted terminal result, and a deterministic regression drives a wall-clock jump through the wait path.
Recorded start and end timestamps that are out of order because of a clock change do not by themselves turn a terminal passed or failed result into UNKNOWN.
disposal_reason: Duplicate: Opus2 filed the same WinB wait-UNKNOWN-after-clock-jump defect (test-15b238f4) as w-504611cff02a (BarA2, TermAl mailbox df007e37 #1572).
